- Found (Session A build pass, branch `feat/S1.9-stats`, 2026-09-26 — five agents on one brief: `schema`, `chart`, `backend`, `admin-page`, `docs`; every decision below was either pre-decided in the brief or reported by an agent as taken beyond it): (1) a PK column cannot be NULL, so data-model's `entity_id uuid null` cannot hold for the site and channel rows — the sentinel IS their id. (2) Storage's REST `list` is one folder level at a time with no recursion and no age filter, while every bucket the U1 scan covers nests objects two or three levels deep — a folder walk has unbounded fan-out, one `security definer` read per bucket does not. (3) A `direct_downloads_day` row keyed on the run day would read as the wrong day to any consumer (`stats_daily(day = X, direct_downloads_day)` is naturally "downloads on X"); the count describes the completed day before the run. (4) The nested `app/admin/layout.tsx` sets a string `title: 'Admin'`, which leaves NO template for its children, so every admin page title is used verbatim — the tab reads `Stats · Admin`, not `Stats · Admin — odsens` (as `Comments · Admin` etc. already do). (5) SVG `<text>` scales with a stretched `preserveAspectRatio="none"` SVG, so "Silkscreen 11 px axis labels" can only hold at every width when the labels are HTML beside / under the well. (6) At the pinned 10-unit column pitch an 8-unit bar leaves a 2-unit gap — ≈ 4–7 px at 390 / 1280 — outside DESIGN.md §11.1's 2–4 px; a 9-unit bar lands inside it. (7) A `<table>` under `.visually-hidden` keeps its content box (381×1024 px measured) — `clip-path: inset(50%)` does the hiding — so a bounding-box "not visible" proof would fail; the class plus the computed clip is the proof. (8) A moderator's RLS-filtered read of `stats_daily` is empty and `sync_runs` is admin-only too (T-RLS-111), so a moderator's page is every tile at `0`, an empty chart and a SYNC board reading STALE / Never — the frozen matrix is not widened; one mute line says why. (9) `sign_in {from}` has been wired since S1.1 (`GoogleSignInButton`, ADR-0014) and T-E2E-16 observes it — nothing to build for AC8. (10) The seed's `stats_daily` days are evaluated at reset time, like the sync_runs ages: a stack reset before UTC midnight and read after it shows the pair one day older (tolerated by the windows; recorded). (11) Supabase Studio's `.emptyFolderPlaceholder` markers would age into orphan candidates — they are folder markers, not failed uploads. (12) `lib/stats.ts` is a stage-1 deliverable of a parallel agent, so the RLS matrix file carries its own `SITE_ENTITY_ID` literal. (13) Importing `lib/jobs/snapshotStats.ts` in the unit lane would load the runner (`next/cache`, `lib/notify/emit`, the admin client), so the job's pure tests live at the top of its db file. (14) A moderator's disabled "Sync now" carries a `useId` id that is not CSS-safe — located with `[id="…"]`. (15) `pnpm typecheck` of a stage-2 agent once tripped on another agent's in-progress test file — resolved in the same pass; the tree typechecks clean.
- Related: follows ADR-0002 #29 (`0` + "No data yet."), #68 (`users` aggregate only), #80 (U1 moved from S1.3.AC11 to S1.9), C15 (`maxDuration` 300), ADR-0030 D1 (the runner owns SC-11 / SC-13 / J-F), ADR-0036 and ADR-0042 (the Support half left this slice), ADR-0014 (`sign_in` wired — D18 verifies only); extends the **ADR-0043 D11 / ADR-0045 D11** `*_SYNC_SOURCES` pattern (D14) and the **ADR-0045 D27** static-markup contract-test precedent (D28); `scripts/check-test-ids.mjs` follows **ADR-0048 D24** (D35). `DESIGN.md` is NOT edited: the chart matches §11.1 as written and the new strings apply the existing §7 voice (ADR-R8 / ADR-R9). Supersedes nothing.

## Decision
**Brief id → decision** (the build brief's working `D-R<n>` ids, kept for the record; the code comments are rewritten to the decision numbers below at integration — the ADR-0045 / ADR-0048 precedent — so nothing in the tree cites a `D-R` id): **D-R1 … D-R25 → D1 … D25 one-to-one (same numbers, same substance)**; D26 onwards records what the build agents decided beyond the brief (the agent id in a trailing parenthesis).

1. **`stats_daily` as built (data-model §2.9 amended).** Migration `supabase/migrations/20260926120000_stats_daily.sql`. Columns `day date not null`, `metric text not null`, `source text not null`, `entity_type text not null`, `entity_id uuid not null` (the sentinel `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000` for site / channel rows — PK columns cannot be null), `value bigint not null`, `created_at timestamptz not null default now()`, `updated_at timestamptz not null default now()` + trigger `stats_daily_set_updated_at` → `set_updated_at()`. PK `stats_daily_pkey (day, metric, source, entity_type, entity_id)`. CHECKs `stats_daily_metric_check` (`downloads, direct_downloads_day, views, subs, comments, comments_held, likes, users, reach, mentions, tips`), `stats_daily_source_check` (`modrinth, curseforge, direct, odsens, youtube, kofi`), `stats_daily_entity_type_check` (`site, project, video, channel`), `stats_daily_value_check` (`value >= 0`). Index `stats_daily_metric_entity_day_idx (metric, source, entity_type, day desc)`. One-line `comment on table`. Idempotent (`if not exists`, `drop … if exists` guards); reversibility `drop table if exists public.stats_daily`. `lib/supabase/types.ts` regenerated: +40 lines — `Tables.stats_daily` Row / Insert / Update and `Functions.list_stale_objects`, nothing else.
2. **RLS = the `sync_runs` matrix (data-model §4 row as written; T-RLS-107..110).** In the same file: `revoke all … from public, anon, authenticated, service_role; grant select, update, delete on stats_daily to authenticated; grant all to service_role;` — NO insert grant and NO insert policy for JWT roles (T-RLS-108 admin = D: rows are only ever written by the job); policies `stats_daily_select_admin` (select, `authenticated`, `is_admin()`), `stats_daily_update_admin` (using + with check `is_admin()`), `stats_daily_delete_admin`. Service bypasses RLS. Grants on the local stack read `authenticated = DELETE, SELECT, UPDATE`, `service_role = ALL`.
3. **RPC `list_stale_objects` (data-model §2.11 / §4 and `_registry.md` SQL amended).** Migration `20260926120100_list_stale_objects.sql`: `public.list_stale_objects(p_bucket text, p_min_age_hours integer, p_limit integer) returns table (name text, created_at timestamptz)` — `language sql`, `stable`, `security definer`, `set search_path = public`; body `select o.name, o.created_at from storage.objects o where o.bucket_id = p_bucket and o.name is not null and o.created_at < now() - make_interval(hours => p_min_age_hours) order by o.created_at asc limit greatest(p_limit, 0)`; `comment on function`; `revoke all … from public, anon, authenticated, service_role; grant execute … to service_role`. It LISTS, it never deletes. Only `bucket_id`, `name`, `created_at` are touched — the columns every storage-api schema version carries — so the migration applies on a hosted project whose storage schema lags the local image (the local `storage.objects` has `archived_at` / `is_delete_marker`, deliberately not referenced). Object names come back WITHOUT the bucket prefix. Why an RPC: Storage's REST `list` is one folder level, no recursion, no age filter; the scanned buckets nest `{id}/{kind}/{file}`. T-RLS-129 leg (D35).
4. **SEED-12 `stats_daily` pinned (05 §3 amended).** Six site rows, sentinel id, metric `downloads`: `day = (now() at time zone 'utc')::date` → modrinth `4099`, curseforge `120`, direct `7` (= the seed projects' live totals 2531 + 1568 / 120 / 7 — sum 4226 → T-E2E-40's `4.2K`, and a first `snapshotStats` run on the pristine seed rewrites today's rows with the SAME values); `day − 1` → `4059`, `117`, `5` (deltas 40 / 3 / 2 → the pristine 7-day tile reads `45`). Arm `on conflict (day, metric, source, entity_type, entity_id) do update set value = excluded.value` (the job's own). No fixed ids (composite PK). Appended to the SEED-12 block of `supabase/seed.sql` as its "S1.9 part"; header line 17 and the sync_runs block sentence updated. `day` is relative to the reset (UTC), like the sync_runs ages (D26 c).
5. **Job order — gather, then write, then housekeeping (04 §3.5 amended).** `lib/jobs/snapshotStats.ts` through `runJob({ source: 'stats', job: 'snapshotStats' })` (ADR-0030 D1); `day = utcDay(new Date())` fixed at entry. Step 1 (service client, `readPaged` at 1,000 ordered by `id` where a table can grow — the `refreshMentions` `readEligible` pattern): `projects` (`id, downloads_modrinth, downloads_curseforge, downloads_direct` — EVERY row, any status); `videos` (`id, view_count, like_count`); `comments` head-counts for `status='published'` and `'held'`; `comments.like_count` paged → sum; `profiles` head-count where `handle is not null`; `mentions` where `status='published'` (`view_count`) → count + sum (nulls = 0); `project_downloads` with `created_at >= day−1T00:00:00Z and < dayT00:00:00Z` (`project_id`, paged) → count per project; LAST, only when `env.YOUTUBE_API_KEY` is set, `createYoutube({ env }).channelStats()` once (1 unit). Step 2: `buildSnapshotRows` (pure) → `upsert` in chunks of `STATS_UPSERT_CHUNK` (500) with `{ onConflict: 'day,metric,source,entity_type,entity_id' }`; `items` = rows built. Any read or upsert failure → `ok=false`, the message as `error`, housekeeping skipped. Step 3: `rpc('purge_project_downloads', { p_days: PROJECT_DOWNLOADS_RETENTION_DAYS })`, `rpc('purge_rate_limit_hits', { p_days: RATE_LIMIT_HITS_RETENTION_DAYS })`, then the U1 sweep (D6). `tags: []` (04 §3.5 revalidates nothing).
6. **U1 orphan cleanup as built (04 §1.4.5 U1 / §3.5 Housekeeping amended).** Buckets scanned = `ORPHAN_BUCKETS` (`project-files`, `project-media`, `art`); `avatars` and `skins` are never listed. Referenced set = every string among `project_files.storage_path`, `projects.icon_url`, `projects.gallery[].url|path`, `project_overrides.extra_gallery[].path|url`, `art.image_path` that starts with a scanned bucket's prefix, kept bucket-prefixed as the DB stores them (SC-21; CDN URLs fall out of that test; gallery jsonb parsed tolerantly, malformed entries ignored). Candidates per bucket = `rpc('list_stale_objects', { p_bucket, p_min_age_hours: ORPHAN_MIN_AGE_HOURS, p_limit: ORPHAN_CLEANUP_MAX })`, compared as `<bucket>/<name>`. `planOrphanRemovals(candidates, referenced, max)` (pure, exported) removes the unreferenced in candidate order (oldest first per bucket, bucket order project-files → project-media → art) up to `ORPHAN_CLEANUP_MAX` in total for the run, `capped: true` when the cap cut the list (the cap is applied in the plan, before any removal — same outcome as "remove until"); removal `db.storage.from(bucket).remove(names)` in chunks ≤ 100. Summary `orphans: { scanned, removed, capped }`. Failure posture and the placeholder rule: D31.
7. **Summary shape.** `{ ok, source: 'stats', run_id, items, ms, day, rows: { project, site, video, channel, direct_days }, purged: { project_downloads, rate_limit_hits }, orphans: { scanned, removed, capped }, units, errors: string[] }` — `errors` ≤ 20 entries × ≤ 300 chars (the `pushError` pattern); `orphans.scanned` = the stale candidates the RPC listed across the three buckets BEFORE the referenced filter, `removed` = the deletions Storage reported (`remove()` data length summed over chunks). Log meta = flat counts only: `units, project, site, video, channel, direct_days, purged_project_downloads, purged_rate_limit_hits, orphans_scanned, orphans_removed, orphans_capped, errors` (+ the runner's `trigger`, `items`).
8. **Route (04 §2.4 / SC-12).** `app/api/cron/stats-snapshot/route.ts` = `app/api/cron/refresh-mentions/route.ts` with the job swapped: GET only (others 405 `Allow: GET`, JSON `validation` "GET only."), `dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`, `runtime = 'nodejs'`, `maxDuration = 300`, `cronAuth` else 401 `{ok:false, error:{code:'unauthorized', message:'Nope.'}}` with no side effects, 200 `JobSummary` (a lock skip is 200 `{ok:true, skipped:'running'}`; the job has no `not_configured` skip — D20), 500 `{ok:false, source, run_id, error:{code:'job_failed', message}}` ("Job failed." fallback), `Cache-Control: no-store`, the `route_unhandled` last resort with `job: 'snapshotStats'` / `source: 'stats'`. `vercel.json` gains `{ "path": "/api/cron/stats-snapshot", "schedule": "0 3 * * *" }` between `refresh-mentions` and `notify` (04 §6 order).
9. **`triggerSync` runs the job (04 §1.7 amended).** `lib/actions/admin.ts` `JOBS` is a full `Record<TriggerSyncInput['source'], (opts) => Promise<JobSummary>>` with `stats: snapshotStats`; the unreachable "That sync isn't built yet." `upstream_error` branch is removed; `await JOBS[data.source]({ trigger: 'manual', full: data.full })`; a lock skip is `conflict` "Already running." as for every source. T-ACT-42's `stats` case is rewritten (D32).
10. **Deltas rule (`lib/stats.ts`).** Per (metric, source): sort the snapshot days; a snapshot day's delta = its value minus the PREVIOUS snapshot day's value (whatever the gap), clamped at ≥ 0, attributed to the later day; the first snapshot has no delta (0); days without a snapshot are absent from the map (the chart reads them as 0). Chart window = the 30 UTC days ending `today` (`today−29 … today`). Compact = 15 buckets of consecutive pairs `(today−29, today−28) … (today−1, today)`, `date` = the pair's first day; totals preserved. `utcDay` / `addDays` / `dayRange` are built from `Date.UTC`, never a local getter (01 INV-68).
11. **Tiles (`buildStatsTiles`; §5 copy).** Windows anchor on the UTC `today` computed at request time. `downloads7` = Σ of the three sources' `downloads` deltas over `today−6 … today`; `prev7` the same over `today−13 … today−7`; context `<formatCount(prev7)> the week before` (tone `up` when downloads7 > prev7, else `neutral`) when a `downloads` row falls in the week before, else `First week counted.`. `downloadsAll` = Σ of the three sources' values at the latest `downloads` snapshot day inside the read window (a source missing that day counts 0); context `Modrinth <m> · CurseForge <c> · direct <d>` through `formatCount`. `comments` = the latest `comments/odsens` value; `held` = `comments_held/odsens` on that same day, else its own latest, else 0; context `<held> held`, `attention` when held > 0. `tips` = Σ `tips/kofi` deltas over `today−29 … today` (0 in v1); context `Ko-fi isn't counted yet.` once a tips row exists in that window. A tile whose window holds no row of its metric = `0` + `No data yet.` (neutral). Reader window `READ_WINDOW_DAYS` = 38 (`today−37 … today` = CHART_DAYS + TILE_WEEK_DAYS + 1); older-only data reads as `No data yet.` — the SYNC board's `stats` row is what makes a dead cron visible. Pristine seed: `45` / `4226` (→ `4.2K`, "Modrinth 4.1K · CurseForge 120 · direct 7") / `0` No data yet. / `0` No data yet.; after a run on the seed: comments `2` + "1 held", tips `0` + "Ko-fi isn't counted yet.".
12. **`FlatBarChart` as built (03 §2.2 row amended; 03 C-03 additive props).** Server Component; props `{ days: DailyDownloads[]; title: string; compact?: boolean; titleId?: string; className?: string }`. ONE root `<div data-variant="both|compact|full">` (class = the CSS-module `flat-bar-chart`, hashed at build like every primitive) renders BOTH variants — `<figure data-full>` (30 columns) and `<figure data-compact>` (15 columns of two-day sums) — toggled by CSS at ≤ 599px (`--bp-phone`; the raw `@media (max-width: 599px)` every neighbour uses — custom properties cannot appear in a media query); the hidden figure is `display: none` and leaves the a11y tree; `compact: true | false` FORCES one variant (the gallery fixtures; any caller that knows its width), `undefined` → both. Each figure is a CSS grid `auto minmax(0, 1fr)` with areas y / well / x / legend / note: an `aria-hidden` Y column (`formatCount(max)`, `formatCount(max / 2)` — a fractional half floors, e.g. 103 → 51 — and `0`; only `0` when max is 0) beside a well (`--slab-sunk`, `outline: 2px solid var(--line-soft)`, `padding: 0 var(--space-4)`, radius 0) holding ONE `<svg role="img" aria-labelledby=<titleId ?? <base>-table-caption> aria-describedby=<base>-full-note|<base>-compact-note preserveAspectRatio="none" viewBox="0 0 <bars*10> 100">`, height 220px full / 180px compact (raw px = geometry, 03 §9); columns `<g data-day="YYYY-MM-DD">` of up to three `<rect data-source="modrinth|curseforge|direct">` stacked bottom → top modrinth · curseforge · direct (`DOWNLOAD_SOURCES` order), `x = i·10 + 0.5`, `width = 9` (D27), heights scaled to the variant's stacked max, 3-decimal attributes with no `-0`; a zero value draws no rect, a zero max none; NO stroke, `rx`, gradient or `<text>`; fills by CSS `rect[data-source='modrinth'] { fill: var(--emerald) }` / `--orange` / `--indigo-lift`. Under the well: the `aria-hidden` end labels `30 DAYS AGO` / `TODAY`; the legend = `SourceSwatch` ×3 (Modrinth · CurseForge · Direct — swatch AND word, once per variant, `--text-small --mute`); the `<figcaption id=…>` LAST (HTML allows first or last) — "15 bars, two days each" (compact, visible, `--text-small --mute-dim`) or "Daily" (full, `visually-hidden`). Every pixel label is an HTML `<span>` in `--font-pixel --text-pixel-11 --track-pixel`, uppercase, `--mute-dim`, so Silkscreen 11px holds at every width while the SVG stretches. The text alternative is ONE `<table class="visually-hidden" data-testid="flat-bar-chart-table">` after the variants: `<caption id="<base>-table-caption">{title}</caption>`, headers Day · Modrinth · CurseForge · Direct · Total, one `<tr>` per daily entry with `<th scope="row">{formatDay(date)}</th>` (UTC — D25) and the RAW integers + total (`String(n)`, not `formatCount` — "the same numbers"). `base = titleId ?? sectionTitleId(title)` (→ `section-title-downloads-last-30-days`), so several charts on one page never collide; the visible `<h2>` is the PARENT's — the component renders no heading. No hover state, no tooltip, nothing interactive; no new token.
13. **`/admin/stats` for moderators (02 §1.3 auth rule applied; RLS not widened).** The page renders for role ≥ moderator (the layout gate; RP-04 quiet bail for anon / no handle / role `user`); the RLS-filtered read (T-RLS-107 mod = D) returns no rows, so a moderator sees every tile at `0` + "No data yet.", an empty 30-column chart, and the one mute line "Only admins see the numbers." (rendered when `viewer.profile.role !== 'admin'`); `SyncStatus canTrigger` = admin, so every "Sync now" is natively `disabled` under `title="Admin only"` with the hidden note, never absent; `sync_runs` is admin-only too (T-RLS-111), so every SYNC row reads STALE / Never for a moderator — the page-computed degradation, no special case.
14. **SYNC board sources.** `STATS_SYNC_SOURCES = ['modrinth', 'curseforge', 'youtube', 'mentions', 'stats'] as const` + `type StatsSyncSource` in `lib/data/admin.ts` (its own stanza right after the `S1.8 block END` marker; `DASHBOARD_SYNC_SOURCES` / `MENTIONS_SYNC_SOURCES` unchanged) — every job that feeds the numbers, so the stats page shows the whole picture and a dead snapshot cron is visible on its own row; "Sync now" on the `stats` row runs `snapshotStats` through `triggerSync` (D9).
15. **Reader.** `lib/data/stats.ts` (`'server-only'`, request-cookie `createServerClient`): `readSiteSnapshots(fromDay: string): Promise<SiteSnapshotRow[]>` = `.from('stats_daily').select('day, metric, source, value').eq('entity_type','site').gte('day', fromDay).in('metric', ['downloads','comments','comments_held','tips']).order('day').order('metric').order('source')` — one read (≤ 38 × 6 rows), no paging, no cache; throws `stats read failed: <code>`; an RLS-empty answer is a normal `[]`; rows mapped `{ day, metric, source, value: Number(value) }` (int8 arrives as a JSON number — the `Number()` guards a client that ever hands back a string); re-exports `type SiteSnapshotRow` from `lib/stats.ts`; the metric tuple is module-private.

28. **Chart and arithmetic — decisions inside D10–D12's frame (agent `chart`).** (a) `buildStatsTiles` clamps its own input to the read window (rows with `day` in `today−37 … today`; earlier or later rows ignored), so "older-only data reads as No data yet." holds whatever the caller read (unit-tested: today−38 → No data yet., today−37 → counted). (b) Without `titleId` each SVG's `aria-labelledby` points at the hidden table's `<caption id="<base>-table-caption">`, which carries `title` — no dangling reference, no heading rendered; every generated id (`-table-caption`, `-full-note`, `-compact-note`) derives from `base`. (c) The Y column and the end-label row are `aria-hidden="true"` (the SVG is named by the heading and described by its figcaption; the table is the text alternative) — the legend words stay in the a11y tree. (d) **Integration (2026-09-26):** each SVG's first child is a `<title>` — the `title` prop, the compact one suffixed `— 15 bars, two days each` — because 05 T-E2E-48's site-wide guard accepts only `aria-hidden` SVGs or `role="img"` + `<title>` (the gallery run failed on the three specimens without it); `aria-labelledby` still wins the accessible name, the `<title>` is its fallback (and the browser's hover tooltip on the chart — accepted); `tests/unit/stats.test.ts`'s "nothing interactive" guard keeps forbidding `<button>` / `tabindex` / `onclick` and no longer names `<title>`. (e) **Integration (2026-09-26):** the text-alternative `<table>` sits inside a `visually-hidden` wrapper `<div>` instead of carrying the class itself — a table ignores the recipe's `width: 1px` (its min-content box wins) and at 390 the three gallery specimens' tables reached x = 393, failing T-E2E-48's `scrollWidth === viewport` guard; the wrapper is the element T-E2E-40 checks for `position: absolute` / `clip-path: inset(50%)` / `overflow: hidden`, the table keeps `data-testid="flat-bar-chart-table"` and its 30 rows. (d) Hidden table cells print raw integers; the row header is `formatDay(date)`. (e) Stack order bottom → top modrinth · curseforge · direct; a zero value draws no `<rect>`; a zero max draws none. (f) Y labels `formatCount(max)`, `formatCount(max / 2)` (floors), `0`; only `0` when max is 0 — one `<span>` per label in a flex column stretched to the SVG height (max at the well's top edge, 0 at its floor). (g) Figure = the CSS grid of D12; legend `--text-small --mute`; compact note `--text-small --mute-dim`. (h) The `<figcaption>` is the figure's LAST child; DOM order per figure: Y column, well + svg, end labels, legend, figcaption. (i) `bucketDays` general rule: pair size = `CHART_DAYS / COMPACT_BARS` = 2; buckets = `max(1, floor(n / 2))`; the last bucket absorbs any remainder (31 → 15 with a 3-day tail, 29 → 14, 1 → 1, 0 → `[]`); `compact = false` returns a deep copy, never the same array. (j) `dailyDeltas`: the last row wins a duplicate (metric, source, day) — defensive only, the PK forbids one; input order does not matter. (k) `utcDay` throws on an invalid `Date` (`stats: invalid date`); `addDays` / `dayRange` throw on anything but `YYYY-MM-DD` (`stats: not a YYYY-MM-DD day: …`) — the `formatDay` precedent, never `NaN-NaN-NaN`. (e) On a gather or upsert failure `items` is 0 and `rows` all zeros even when an earlier 500-row chunk had been upserted — those are the same idempotent rows the next run rewrites (the seed's 35 rows are one chunk).

### Notes — built details judged within the spec's latitude (no deviation; listed so `spec-drift-reviewer` can check them)
- `lib/stats.ts` has no directive and no server import; `lib/data/stats.ts` imports `'server-only'` and the request-cookie client only (01 INV-12 / INV-14 / INV-15); the service client appears in no `lib/data/**` file and in no page.
- `lib/jobs/snapshotStats.ts` contains no `.delete(` and no `delete from` — the deletions are the two purge RPCs and `storage.remove()` (04 J-D; 01 INV-24's grep matches nothing, which is compliant).
- The route is byte-for-byte the `refresh-mentions` shape (401 / 405 / 500 / `no-store` / `maxDuration`); `cronAuth` is the shared timing-safe helper; no query parameter is read.
- `users/odsens` is ONE head-count of `profiles where handle is not null` — no per-user row anywhere (ADR-0002 #68).
- Every `.module.css` is tokens-only (`scripts/contrast.mjs --check styles/` → OK); the S1.9 CSS uses existing tokens (`--slab-sunk`, `--line-soft`, `--emerald`, `--orange`, `--indigo-lift`, `--font-pixel`, `--text-pixel-11`, `--track-pixel`, `--mute-dim`, `--mute`, `--text-small`, `--space-*`); no new token, no new `data-state` value, hence no DESIGN.md edit (ADR-R8 not triggered).
- Gate notes for Session B: `security-reviewer` — the page reads on the cookie client (`grep -rn "supabase/admin" app/admin/stats lib/data/stats.ts` → nothing), the cron secret is checked before any work, the RPC is `service_role`-only and read-only; `supabase-reviewer` — D1–D3 and the seed arm; `backend-reviewer` — D5 / D21 / D31 and the 99 % / 87.67 % coverage of the job file; `frontend-reviewer` — D12 / D28 (the a11y contract) and D33; `design-fidelity-reviewer` — D12 / D27 (geometry inside §11.1's range); `deploy-checker` — the `vercel.json` row and the 401.

## Alternatives considered
| Alternative | Why not |
|---|---|
| A Storage REST folder walk for the U1 candidates (D3 / D6) | `list` is one folder level at a time with no recursion and no age filter; the scanned buckets nest `{id}/{kind}/{file}` — unbounded fan-out per run against one `stable` read per bucket. |
| Per-source deltas from the `downloads` snapshots for the direct series too, no `direct_downloads_day` (D19 / D29) | The snapshot delta is the chart's series (D10); `direct_downloads_day` is the exact per-day count from the raw log the spec asks for (04 §3.5 (e)) — both exist, for different readers. |
| Date the `direct_downloads_day` row on the run day (the literal 04 §3.5 Idempotency sentence) (D29) | `stats_daily(day = X, direct_downloads_day)` reads as "downloads on X" to every consumer; the count describes day − 1. The window is unchanged. |
| Widen the `stats_daily` select policy to `is_moderator()` so moderators see numbers (D13) | The frozen RLS matrix says mod = D (T-RLS-107); `sync_runs` is admin-only too. The layout already lets moderators in; one mute line explains the zeros. |
| A client island that picks the variant from `window.innerWidth` (D12) | No client JS is the whole point of the `S` mark (03 §2.2, 01 INV-10 as read by O-23); two server-rendered figures and one CSS rule cost nothing at runtime. |
| SVG `<text>` for the axis labels (D12) | It scales with the stretched `preserveAspectRatio="none"` SVG; "Silkscreen 11 px" would be 11 px at one width only. HTML spans beside / under the well hold at every width. |
| Bars 8 units wide at the 10-unit pitch (the brief's wording) (D27) | A 2-unit gap is ≈ 4–7 px at 390 / 1280 — outside DESIGN.md §11.1's 2–4 px; 9 units gives ≈ 2–4 px. |
| `entity_id uuid null` with a partial unique index instead of the sentinel in the PK (D1) | data-model and 01 INV-97 name a composite PK; a PK column cannot be NULL; the registry already fixed the sentinel. |
| Apply the U1 cap while removing ("remove until 200") (D6) | The same outcome computed in one pure, unit-testable place (`planOrphanRemovals`); the db leg proves the removals, the pure cases prove the cap. |
| Remove what can be removed when one reference read fails (D31) | An incomplete reference set could name a live object an orphan; a missed sweep costs nothing, a deleted live object costs a picture. |
| Treat `.emptyFolderPlaceholder` objects as orphans (D31) | They are Studio's folder markers, not failed uploads; deleting them empties folders in the Studio UI for no gain. |
| A bounding-box "not visible" proof for the hidden table (D34) | A `<table>` under `.visually-hidden` keeps its content box (381×1024 px measured); the class plus `clip-path: inset(50%)` is what hides it. |
| Hard-coded tile literals after the cron run in T-E2E-40 (D34) | A stray direct download or comment left by an earlier serial flow would fail the leg; the seed-pure literals are asserted BEFORE the run, the post-run values derived from service reads. |
| A `makeStatsRow` factory (D26) | The PK is composite — the id-list factory tracking does not fit; arranged rows on `2000-01-01` are outside every window and swept in `afterAll`. |
| The job's pure tests in a `tests/unit/jobs/` file (D32) | Importing the job loads the runner (`next/cache`, `lib/notify/emit`, the admin client) in the unit lane. |

## Consequences
- Positive: one row per (day, metric, source, entity) with the CHECKs closing the vocabulary; two runs a day are byte-idempotent; the U1 sweep is one read per bucket with a hard cap and a fail-closed reference set; a dead cron is visible on the SYNC board within a day and the tiles say "No data yet." rather than a stale number after 38 days; the page is one component tree for admin and moderator; the chart ships with no client JS, exact fixed colours, a real text alternative and 11 px labels at every width; the whole slice is covered by db, unit and e2e legs on existing ids.
- Negative: `direct_downloads_day` rows carry a different `day` than the rest of a run (D29 — documented in 04 §3.5); the first ~38 days of production have thin tiles (the 7-day tile reads "First week counted." until a second week exists); the seed's `stats_daily` pair drifts by a day across a UTC midnight after a reset (tolerated); the Storage `remove()` failure arm is untested; a moderator's SYNC board reads all STALE (the RLS matrix, not a bug); the T-E2E-40 describe deletes and restores `sync_runs` rows for `mentions` / `stats` (serial, restored); the compact chart's Y labels floor a fractional half.
- Follow-ups: a Storage REST fault hook in `tests/helpers/dbFault.ts` to cover the `remove()` failure arm → `test-engineer`; the seed `stats_daily` day drift → `touchSeedSyncRuns`-style arrange if T-E2E-40 ever flakes (`test-engineer`); `docs/data-model.md` §5's `kofi_events` read → S2.1; the vercel-ops skill's cron table missing `refresh-mentions` → `keep-docs` (S1.8 leftover); Session B flips this ADR to Accepted at merge (`keep-docs`); the first production run at 03:00 UTC is the first real `channels.list` unit against the corrected `YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID` (verify the channel rows the morning after).
